infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Health Vault uses Face ID to keep your medical records secure.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Health Vault uses the camera to scan and upload medical documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Health Vault accesses your photos to upload medical documents.
